h1.en: Power Cell Diesel 40 Concrete Pump Prints: 66 kW beside the Gear article
h1.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么：对照「齿轮」时，66 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine (Power) is 4108 / 66 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：柴油机功率是4108 / 66 kW。画面「Road roller」的主体是Steam 发动机 Lausanne 2。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear. The picture shows Gear. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine (Power) is 4108 / 66 kW. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Theoretical Output remains 26 m³/h. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear。画面是Gear。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：柴油机功率是4108 / 66 kW。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. Diesel Engine (Power) is 4108 / 66 kW. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 25 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 画面「Road roller」的主体是Steam 发动机 Lausanne 2。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Main-unit weight is 2800 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

body.en: The frame “Road roller” shows Steam engine Lausanne 2. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

question.en: What power text does Diesel 40 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Diesel Engine (Power) is 4108 / 66 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear.
answer.zh: 柴油机功率是4108 / 66 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 25 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是26 m³/h。最大出口压力是25 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear画面里印出的数字。
